description: This Java source file defines the 'CommonWorkers' utility class in the 'org.apache.ofbiz.common' package. It provides static methods for retrieving geographic data such as country and state lists, associated regions, and a utility for checking parent types within entity hierarchies. It interacts with the OFBiz entity engine and utility classes to perform database queries and data processing.

classes.name: CommonWorkers
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for geographic data retrieval and entity hierarchy checks within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of country geo entities, prioritizing the default country and including available countries, ordered by name.

methods.name: getStateList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of geographic entities representing states, provinces, territories, or municipalities.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateList
methods.description: Returns a list of regional geo associations, including states and related regions, optionally ordered.

methods.name: hasParentType
methods.description: Checks if a given entity type has a specified parent type in its hierarchy, delegated to EntityTypeUtil.
